web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2019/12/hector-lombard-vs-joe-riggs-to-headline-bkfc-10|title=Hector Lombard vs. Joe Riggs to headline BKFC 10 in February|author=Nolan King|publisher=mmajunkie.com|date=December 16, 2019}} ===Background=== [[Joe Riggs]] was scheduled to face [[Héctor Lombard]] in the main event, however Riggs suffered an injury in training and withdrew from the fight. [[David Mundell (fighter)|David Mundell]] served as Riggs replacement, taking the short notice fight against Lombard. This event also featured the first two quarter-final bouts of the Tournament to crown the first BKFC Super welterweight Championship. Memorial Auditorium]] in [[Birmingham, Alabama|Birmingham]], [[United States|USA]]. However, the event was postponed indefinitely due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2020/3/19/21186786/bkfc-12-to-be-postponed|title=BKFC 12 to be postponed|date=March 19, 2020|publisher=mmafighting.com}} It was later rescheduled to take place on August 21, 2020, at the [[Intrust Bank Arena]] in [[Wichita, Kansas]]. However, it was then pushed back further to September 11, 2020, and moved to the [[Ocean Center]] convention center in [[Daytona Beach, Florida]], [[United States|USA]].{{cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2020/7/28/21345872/thiago-alves-draws-phil-baroni-in-bare-knuckle-debut-hector-lombard-vs-kendall-grove-tap-bkfc-13|title=Thiago Alves draws Phil Baroni in bare-knuckle debut, Hector Lombard vs. Kendall Grove on tap for BKFC 13|author=Damon Martin|publisher=mmafighting.com|date=July 28, 2020}} [[Thiago Alves (fighter)|Thiago Alves]] was originally scheduled to face [[Phil Baroni]] in the main event.
